channel.title: anaconda.org/conda-test
channel.description: The most recent 7 updates for conda-test.

item.title: ipygoldenlayout 0.4.0 [noarch]
item.description: ipygoldenlayout wraps the GoldenLayout JavaScript layout manager as an ipywidget, providing dockable, resizable and draggable panes for use in Jupyter notebooks and other ipywidgets front-ends.

item.title: ipypopout 2.0.1 [noarch]
item.description: ipypopout provides a button widget that detaches any ipywidget into its own browser window, keeping it synchronised with the originating kernel. It is useful for multi-monitor dashboards built with ipyvuetify or solara.

item.title: ipysplitpanes 0.2.0 [noarch]
item.description: ipysplitpanes exposes the splitpanes Vue component as an ipywidget, allowing resizable split layouts to be composed from Python in Jupyter notebooks and other ipywidgets front-ends.

item.title: ipyvuedraggable 1.1.0 [noarch]
item.description: ipyvuedraggable makes the Vue.Draggable component available as an ipywidget, adding drag-and-drop sorting of lists and grids to ipyvue based user interfaces.

item.title: jdaviz 5.0.2 [noarch]
item.description: jdaviz is a package of astronomical data analysis visualization tools based on the Jupyter platform. It bundles the Specviz, Cubeviz, Mosviz and Imviz configurations used to explore JWST and other observatory data, either from a notebook or from the standalone command line application.

item.title: stdatamodels 6.0.0 [noarch]
item.description: stdatamodels provides the DataModel base classes and ASDF schema support shared by the JWST and Roman calibration pipelines, wrapping FITS and ASDF files in validated, attribute-style Python objects.

item.title: goats 26.11.0rc2 [linux-64, osx-64]
item.description: Gemini Observation and Analysis of Targets System.
